utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is case number IT-08-91-T, the Prosecutor versus Mico Stanisic and Stojan Zupljanin.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Thank you, Madam Registrar. May we have the appearances for today, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. DOBBYN
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. For the Prosecution Gerard Dobbyn, with Joanna Korner, and our case manage Crispian Smith.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Slobodan Zecevic, Slobodan Cvijetic, Tatjana Savic, and Deirdre Montgomery appearing for Stanisic Defence this morning. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. PANTELIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. For Zupljanin Defence this morning, Igor Pantelic, Dragan Krgovic, and Stephanie Cagnet. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Thank you. Would the usher please escort the witness back to the stand.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Sorry. We would go into closed session before the witness is brought back to the stand.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 3rd day of March, 2010, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.19 p.m.,
